description: AKOÚŌ v0.9 integration example: a human listening responds to an agent record without merging records, asserting same-source identity, pass influence, or an ear swarm.

agent_listening_output.object_listened_to: an agent observation associated with a local acoustic event

inferred.statement: The model report describes a brief pulse followed by a quieter interval.
inferred.basis: Attributed model output; the agent does not convert it into an embodied hearing.

undetermined.statement: Whether the later human response concerns the identical acoustic source is undetermined.
undetermined.basis: A response link is not a verified same-source relation.

what_appears: An attributable model observation is available.
what_remains_hidden: No embodied hearing is attributed to the agent.
The identity of the acoustic source is not established by the response link.

technical: The report is mediated by an unspecified model process.
bodily: The agent has no embodied auditory aperture.
archival: The record preserves the model observation separately from later human accounts.
computational: The model output remains attributed as model evidence.

hallucination: Do not promote a model observation into a heard claim.
forensic_overreach: Do not infer identical source events from an ordinary response link.
source_confusion: Keep the model report distinct from the represented sound and human response.

agent_listening_output.main_reading: The agent account remains a model-attributed observation with an explicit epistemic boundary.
agent_listening_output.alternative_reading: A verified source digest could later support a separate same-source relation without merging the records.

known_blind_spots: No embodied auditory aperture and no verified source identity.

position.relation_to_object: remote reading of an attributed model observation
limitations: No human or machine claim in this record verifies a shared source with a later response.

apertures.description: The model output supplied to the agent.
limits: It is not an embodied hearing or signal measurement.

listening_sources.label: attributed agent model observation
limitations: The source event and model lineage are not verified in this example.

human_listening_output.object_listened_to: a human listening later linked as a response to an agent observation

heard.statement: The listener reports a brief pulse followed by a quieter interval.
heard.basis: First-person human report through a declared direct auditory aperture.

undetermined.statement: The human account does not establish that its acoustic source is identical to the source represented by the agent record.
undetermined.basis: The records are connected only by response_to.

what_appears: An attributable first-person human hearing is available.
what_remains_hidden: The response relation does not prove source identity or causal influence between listening passes.

spatial: The precise location is intentionally absent from this public example.
bodily: The hearing is situated in one human listener's embodied auditory aperture.
archival: The human account remains a separate, revisable record.
computational: The linked agent record does not supply the human hearing.

over_identification: Do not generalize one listener's account into consensus.
forensic_overreach: Do not infer same-source identity from response_to.
source_confusion: Keep the human report distinct from the linked model observation.

human_listening_output.main_reading: The human record may carry a heard claim because it resolves to a human participant, pass, aperture, and human-report source.
human_listening_output.alternative_reading: A later verified source digest could justify a separate same-source relation while preserving both accounts.

known_blind_spots: No calibrated measurement or verified source digest is available.

position.relation_to_object: first-person embodied listening linked to an agent record after the listening pass
limitations: The response relation alone does not establish a shared acoustic source.

apertures.description: The human listener's declared auditory aperture.
limits: The account is not a calibrated signal measurement.

listening_sources.label: first-person human auditory report
limitations: This is an attributed report, not a calibrated measurement or independent source-identity proof.
